capabilities: Search TMDB, AniList, and Apple Music for titles in Korean or English
Create notes with poster, credits, and media details
Rate works with half-star ratings, status, and a one-line review
Fill existing notes with media info without overwriting reviews
Edit per-media-type note templates that skip empty variables
extras: A free TMDB API key is only needed for movies and series; anime, webtoons, manga, and albums need no key. Album searches use the US store by default because the Korean store doesn't sell music. The plugin is Korean-first with full English support.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to record watched, read, or listened media with fetched details like posters, credits, and ratings.

relations.evidence: Anime, webtoon, and manga data: AniList.
Album data: Apple iTunes Search API.

summary: Media diary plugin that logs movies, series, anime, webtoons, manga, and albums with TMDB/AniList/Apple Music search, half-star ratings, and one-line reviews.
